verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows a natural-language interface for users to operate Aircall itself, such as a command bar or chat assistant that runs product actions. The AI Assistants give in-call guidance and automate notes and CRM updates. The AI Agents answer callers' requests. Both are related AI features, not natural-language control of the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
